messages:
marta: Heads-up: I noticed the Quickstart 'Cost & latency breakdown' example uses `cost_units: 0.002` but the SDK snippets in examples/go/cost_breakdown.go and examples/python/cost_breakdown.py assume per-token microcosts (units in micros). The mismatch makes the Go example show a 1000x inflated cost in the playground preview.

leo: omg that's bad. where did the units change come from? was this from the recent pricing schema PR?

tara: PR #1177 changed the docs sample to show a human-friendly decimal but didn't update the SDK helpers which expect integer micro-units. I think the change was intended for the marketing quickstart but accidentally landed in the docs repo.

sam: we should do 3 things: 1) hotfix the quickstart examples to use explicit units (e.g., `cost_units_micros: 2000`) or annotate the field, 2) update SDK snippets to accept either micros or decimals with a helper, and 3) add a migration blurb in Console -> Observability -> Cost to explain the historical ambiguity.

marta: agreed. i'd prefer we keep the docs canonical (micros) to match SDKs and backend. if we want friendly decimals, add a separate "human-readable" field in the marketing quickstart only.

leo: i'll open a docs PR to revert the human-friendly change in the quickstart and add an explicit example with comment: `# units: micros (1e-6)` and show the conversion math.

lighthouse-bot: Broken link detected: docs/console/observability/costs.md references /sdk/go#costhelpers which 404s. See https://lighthouse.redwood/checks/3281

tara: good catch. the SDK snippet was moved under /sdk/go/helpers/costs.md last week. i'll fix the anchor and add a permanent redirect.

sam: for SDKs, i can add a small helper function in Go/Python that normalizes input: accepts a float (human decimal) or int (micros) and returns micros. Add docstring that clarifies behavior. We'll also add a deprecation note for floats.

marta: can we coordinate ordering? Docs PR first, fix link + regenerate snippets, then SDK PR with helper and tests. We don't want playground to show inconsistent outputs while people try quickstarts.

leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1189 65  Revert quickstart units, add conversion math and inline example. Requesting tara for linkfix.

tara: PR opened to update anchors and add redirect file: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1190. CI: linkcheck flagged other old anchors, listing in PR description.

sam: SDK PR inbound: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/432 65  adds NormalizeCostToMicros(value interface{}) (tests included). I'll leave a TODO to remove float support after 3 months.

lighthouse-bot: Docs CI: linkcheck passed for PR 1189; example generation job succeeded for examples that reference cost helpers.

marta: timeline: merge docs PRs 1189 and 1190, regenerate snippets (leo), merge sdk PR 432, then run full playground smoke test for Quickstart flows (30m). If any cost mismatch appears open rollback plan: revert docs PR 1189.

leo: assigned: leo -> regenerate snippets + quick playground QA; tara -> link redirects + docs review; sam -> SDK helper + tests; marta -> final signoff and release note.

marta: thanks all. i'll add a short "Cost unit conventions" FAQ in the Console docs and link to the SDK helper page. :white_check_mark:
